t: Tali HQ is an app where you run your small business with Tali, an AI teammate who remembers your business. You chat to her like you would message someone on your team. She keeps your clients and leads, drafts your messages, emails and invoices, sets your reminders, writes you a morning brief and helps you close the day. She remembers what you tell her, so you never explain your business twice. One rule sits under everything: Tali never sends, spends or changes anything without your yes. Anything she writes to go out waits on your Today screen until you tap it. See Approvals . Today, the first screen you see each time you open Tali HQ

Where to use it # Tali HQ runs in your browser on iPhone, Android and computer at talihq.com.au . On your phone, open it in your browser and add it to your home screen, and it works like any other app. Your account, chats and data are the same on every device.

The three plans # Every new account starts with a free 7 day trial of Tali HQ. No card needed. When the trial ends you drop to Free unless you choose a plan. Full details are on Plans, credits and billing . Free Tali HQ Pro Price A$0 A$19.99 a month, or A$203.90 a year A$49.99 a month, or A$509.90 a year Chat with Tali 250 messages a month 1,000 credits a month 3,000 credits a month Drafts, reminders, clients and leads Yes Yes Yes Journal, notes, food and training, Sleep Yes Yes Yes End of day shutdown Yes Yes Yes Check-in from Tali Friday check-in Morning brief every day Morning brief every day Photos in chat Yes Yes Yes PDFs in chat and web search No Yes Yes Gmail or Outlook sorted, Google or Outlook calendar No Yes Yes Invoices, Stripe, Money, Goals, Weekly review No Yes Yes Business health checks and Tali's weekly journal No Yes Yes Tali's own email address No No Yes Night school, Rules, Patterns No No Yes The 7 day trial Trial gives you everything in the Tali HQ column. Pro features (Tali's email address, Night school, Rules and Patterns) are not part of the trial. Throughout this guide, badges show which plans have a feature: Free means every plan, Tali HQ means Tali HQ and P

Finding your way around # Five tabs sit along the bottom of the app. Today : your day, read for you. What's due, drafts waiting for your yes, your brief and your numbers. See Today and your morning brief . Talk : chat with Tali. See Talk to Tali . Clients : your clients and leads. See Clients and leads . Journal : your journal and notes, and Tali's own weekly journal. See Journal and notes . Me : your plan, Settings, Tali's jobs (Sleep, Money, Invoices, Email and more) and everything Tali knows about you. See What Tali knows and Settings and account .

Best first steps # Make your account and confirm your email. See Getting started . Open Talk and tell Tali about your business: what you do, who your clients are and what keeps you busy. Add a few clients or just tell Tali about them ("Priya Nair is a new client, follow up Friday"). On the trial or a paid plan, connect your Gmail or Outlook and calendar in Me , Settings , Connections . See Gmail and Outlook . Pick your morning brief time in Settings . Tali says Tell me the boring stuff too. Who's slack at paying, who likes 6am, what you're sick of doing. That's where I earn my keep.

Questions # Do I need Totality or Totality Nutrition to use Tali HQ? No. Tali HQ is its own app with its own sign up. You don't need any other app or subscription. Is Tali a real person? No. Tali is an AI. She drafts and suggests, and anything she wants to send, spend or change waits for your yes. Is there an App Store or Google Play version? Use Tali HQ in your browser at talihq.com.au and add it to your home screen. It works on iPhone, Android and computer. Who makes Tali HQ? Totality 360, the Australian team behind Totality and Totality Nutrition. How do I get help? Read Troubleshooting and the FAQ , or email admintotality@gmail.com and a real person will help.

t: Setting up takes about two minutes. You make an account, tap the link in the email Tali sends you, tell her a bit about your business, and she shows you around.

Make your account # Make your account Check your email Open talihq.com.au in your browser. On your phone, you can add it to your home screen first (in Safari tap Share, then Add to Home Screen ; in Chrome tap the menu, then Add to Home screen or Install app ). Tap New here? Make an account . Fill in First name , Email and Password . Your password needs at least 8 characters. Tap Make my account . The Check your email screen appears. Open the email from Tali HQ and tap the link to confirm your address. Come back to Tali HQ and sign in with your email and password. Your 7 day free trial of Tali HQ starts the moment the account is made. No card needed. Trial Email not there? Check your junk or spam folder. Still nothing after a few minutes? Tap Resend email . If you typed the wrong address, tap Wrong email? Start again and fill the form in again.

Sign in # Sign in Type your Email and Password and tap Sign in . If you forget your password, type your email in the box first, then tap Forgot password . Tali emails you a link to set a new one. See Troubleshooting if you get stuck.

Tell Tali about your business # The first time you sign in, you see Let's get you set up . Onboarding Check First name . This is what Tali calls you. Add your Business name if you have one. It's optional. Under What kind of business , tap the closest match: Personal trainer, Gym or studio, Coach or consultant, Trades, Health and beauty, Online business or Something else. You have to pick one. In Anything I should know? , write a line or two about your business, up to 1,000 characters. For example, "I train 20 clients, I'm hopeless at follow-ups and I want more referrals." Optional, but it helps. Tap Meet Tali . Tali also saves your device's time zone, so your brief, reminders and shutdown land at the right local time. You can change your name and business details later in Settings . If this isn't your account (a shared device, or you signed up with the wrong email), tap Not you? Sign out .

The quick tour # Next, Tali walks you around the app in 11 short cards. Each one points at a part of Today or a tab at the bottom: your brief, Tali's level, Needs your yes, Due today, At a glance, then the Talk, Clients, Journal and Me tabs. The tour starts Each card points at a part of the screen Tap Next to move on, Back to go back, or Skip tour at the top to finish straight away. It only shows once. To see it again, open Me and tap Show me around again .

What to do next # Open Talk and tell Tali about your business. The more she knows, the more useful she gets. Pick your morning brief time in Me , Settings . On the trial, connect your Gmail or Outlook and calendar. See Gmail and Outlook . Turn on notifications so you hear when your brief lands. See Settings and account .

Questions # How long is the free trial? 7 days of Tali HQ from the moment you make your account. You don't need a card to start it. What happens when my trial ends? You move to the Free plan automatically. Nothing is deleted. To keep the Tali HQ features, open Me , tap See plans , then Keep Tali HQ after my trial . See Plans, credits and billing . Do I have to fill in the "Anything I should know?" box? No, but it's worth it. Tali reads it before every chat and brief. Can I change my business type later? Yes. Open Me , then Settings , change it under What kind of business and tap Save . I never got the confirmation email. Check junk and spam, then tap Resend email on the Check your email screen. If you closed that screen, go to the sign in screen and try to sign in; Tali will remind you that a confirmation email is waiting. Still stuck? Email admintotality@gmail.com. Can I skip the tour and see it later? Yes. Tap Skip tour , then any time later open Me and tap Show me around again .

t: Today is the first screen you see. Tali reads your day for you and puts it in one place: what's due, what's waiting for your yes, how the business is going and your brief. Pull down on the screen at any time to refresh it. Today on the trial, with the days left under the greeting

The top card # The purple card at the top has: Your greeting : Morning, Afternoon or Evening, with your first name. In the last 30 days of a trial, a line under it says how many days you have left, for example "5 days left of your Tali HQ trial". Tali's line : one sentence that sums up the page, like "You've got 3 things due today, 3 drafts waiting for your yes". When nothing is on, she says so. Read your brief : shows when today's morning brief has landed. Tali HQ Tali's level : her level, name and XP, and how far to the next level. See What Tali knows . After you shut the day down, this card turns into a night sky. See Shut the day down and night mode .

Your morning brief Tali HQ # Every morning at the time you pick, Tali writes your brief: what's on your calendar and the free gaps (when connected), emails that need you, reminders and follow-ups due, unpaid or overdue invoices, anything in your business health worth a look, what's waiting for your yes, today's training session if you have a plan, and one nudge. The brief opened on Today Tap Read your brief on the top card. The brief opens with its headline and the first three lines. Tap Show all to see the rest, or Close to fold it. Tap Got it once you've read it. It then counts as read. Pick your brief time in Me , Settings , under Morning brief time : any half hour from 5:30am to 9:00am. Each brief uses 1 credit. On the Free plan Free has no daily brief. You get a Friday check-in from Tali instead, at the time set under Morning brief time . It appears under More from Tali , Earlier notes . Free

Needs your yes # Anything Tali has drafted for you, like a message, an email, an invoice or a booking, waits here. Tap a draft to open it, then copy it, send it, ask Tali to rework it, or tap Not needed . Full details are on Approvals .

Due today Free # Reminders and client follow-ups that are due today (or overdue) show here. Due today with two reminders and a follow-up Tap the circle to tick a reminder or follow-up off. Under a reminder, tap Tomorrow to move it to 9am tomorrow, or Delete to remove it. Delete asks "Sure?" first, so tap again to confirm. Tap a follow-up to open that person. See Clients and leads . Add a reminder yourself # Adding a reminder Tap + Add a reminder under Due today. Type what to remind you about, for example "Chase Lou about his invoice". Pick a time: In an hour , This arvo (3pm, or an hour from now if it's already past 3), Tomorrow 9am , Monday 9am or Next week . Tap Remind me . Adding reminders yourself is free and uses no credits. You can also just tell Tali in Talk: "remind me to call Zack on Friday at 10". If notifications are on, Tali sends a short notification when a reminder is due.

At a glance # Up to four tiles with one number each. Tap a tile to slide its full card up from the bottom, and tap Close to put it away. At a glance A tile opened Money Tali HQ : what's late, or your runway, or cash in this month. See Money . Health Tali HQ : your business health. "All good" or how many things need a look. See below. This week Tali HQ : how many of your three promises for the week are done, or that your weekly review is due. See Goals and weekly review . Goals Tali HQ : how far along your first goal is. Tiles only show when there is something in them. Business health Tali HQ # Tali checks your business for these, every time you open Today: invoices that are overdue (red once the oldest is more than 14 days late) client follow-ups that are overdue (red when there are more than 3) active clients with no contact in 2 weeks new leads with no follow-up set after 2 days drafts waiting for your yes more than 2 days reminders overdue by more than a day Twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening (Sydney time), if anything is amber or red, Tali sends you one notification about it (at most once every 12 hours).

More from Tali # The quieter things live in a row of chips at the bottom. Tap one to open it. More from Tali, with Your day open Calendar Tali HQ : today's events and free gaps from your connected Google or Outlook calendar. Your day Free : food, training and weight. See Food and training . Tali noticed Pro : this month's patterns. See What Tali knows . Decisions Free : your latest decision. See Decisions . Earlier notes Free : older briefs, health checks and Friday check-ins. Tap one to read it in full. Meeting nudge Tali HQ # With a calendar connected, if one of today's events matches a client (their email is on the invite, or their name is in the title), Today shows "Meeting" with that person, the time, and the top things Tali knows about them. New email nudge Tali HQ # When an email needs you (from your Gmail or Outlook, or sent to Tali's own address on Pro), a card near the top says who it's from. Tap it to open Email. See Tali's email address .

Questions # Why don't I see a morning brief? The daily brief is part of Tali HQ and Pro (and the trial). It lands at the time set in Settings, so if it's earlier than that, it isn't there yet. On Free you get a Friday check-in instead. Can I change when my brief arrives? Yes. Me , Settings , Morning brief time , pick a time, then tap Save . Does ticking off a reminder cost credits? No. Reminders, ticking things off and adding reminders yourself never use credits. What does "This arvo" mean? 3pm today. If it's already past 3pm, it sets the reminder for an hour from now. Why is a tile missing from At a glance? Tiles only show when they have something to say, and Money, Health, This week and Goals are Tali HQ features. With no goals, there is no Goals tile. How do I get rid of a reminder I don't need? Tap Delete under it, then tap again when it says Sure? .

t: The shutdown is two minutes with Tali at the end of the day. You say how it went, note one thing that went well, get anything on your mind out of your head, and set tomorrow's three. Tali signs off with one line, the day is closed, and Today goes into night mode. Free

p: Shut the day down and night mode
t: When it shows up # From two hours before your shutdown time, a Tonight card appears on Today with Shut the day down and a Start button. Your shutdown time is 9pm unless you change it. The Tonight card on Today in the evening If Nudge me to shut down is on in Settings, Tali also sends one notification at your shutdown time if the day isn't closed yet. You can start a shutdown any time from Me , Tali's jobs , Shut the day down .

p: Shut the day down and night mode
t: Do your shutdown # How did today go? Tomorrow's three Tap Start on the Tonight card (or open it from Me). Under How did today go? , tap one: Rough, Meh, Fine, Good or Great. You have to pick one. In One thing that went well , write something. Even a small one counts. Anything on your mind (optional) : get it out of your head. Check Tomorrow's three . Tali fills these in from what's due tomorrow and this week's commitments. Change any line, or clear it. Line 1 is the one thing that matters most; 2 and 3 are optional. Tap Done . Tali then: saves your answers, and puts "what went well" and your note into your journal as an entry called Shutdown (skipped if both are empty) turns each of tomorrow's three into a reminder at 9am tomorrow (lines that already match an open reminder are skipped) writes you one short sign off line The shutdown uses 1 credit on the trial and paid plans. On Free it counts as one of your 250 messages.

p: Shut the day down and night mode
t: After you're done # Day closed The screen says G'night with Tali's line, how today went and tomorrow's three. Tap G'night to go back to Today. Changed your mind? Tap Change my answers , edit anything, and tap Done again. That uses another credit (or message on Free). Tap Keep what I had to leave it as it was.

t: Night mode # Once the day is closed, the top card on Today turns into a night sky. Tali shows her sign off line, asks Bed time? and the brief button is swapped for Sleep sounds . A Day closed card shows your mood and tomorrow's three. Today in night mode Tap Sleep sounds to open Sleep. See Sleep sounds and wind down . Night mode lasts until the next day.

p: Shut the day down and night mode
t: Change your shutdown time # Open Me , then Settings . Under Shut the day down , pick a time from 5:00pm to 10:00pm. Turn Nudge me to shut down on or off. Tap Save . Tali says Two minutes. That's it. Dump it on me, pick tomorrow's three, then go and be a person for a bit.

p: Shut the day down and night mode

t: Talk is where you chat with Tali. Write to her like you'd message someone on your team. She answers, and from the same message she can add a client, set a reminder, draft a message, log your lunch or remember something about your business.

Start a chat # Tap Talk at the bottom. A brand new chat shows four starters: Help me plan my week , Write a follow-up for a client who went quiet , Give me 3 post ideas for this week and What should I focus on to grow? Tap one to put it in the box, or type your own. A new chat A chat in progress Type in the Message Tali box. A message can be up to 2,000 characters. Tap Send . While Tali works, the line under her name says Thinking... . Her reply appears. If she did something as well, a short line above the box says what, for example "Draft waiting on Today, reminder set, saved 1 thing to remember." The line under the chat says what Tali did

s: What Tali can do from a message
t: What Tali can do from a message # Just ask in plain words. She only does these when you ask. Remember things Free : facts about you, your business, people and preferences. Up to three new things per message. See What Tali knows . Draft messages and posts Free : texts, follow-ups, social posts. They wait on Today for you to copy and send. See Approvals . Add or update clients and leads Free : "Zack Donaldson is a new lead, follow up Thursday." Set reminders Free : "remind me to ring Lou at 4pm tomorrow". With no time given, she uses 9am on that day. Log a decision Free : "I've decided to raise PT to $90 from January because costs are up." See Decisions . Log food, weight and training, and write you a programme Free : see Food and training . Draft an invoice Tali HQ : "invoice Priya for 4 PT sessions at $80." See Invoices . Save and update goals Tali HQ : "my goal is 5 more regular clients by February." See Goals and weekly review . Draft emails from your Gmail or Outlook, and calendar bookings Tali HQ : needs Google or Microsoft connected. See Gmail and Outlook . Search the web Tali HQ : for things that change, like prices, rules, news and local businesses. She names her sources. Up

Your chats # Tali remembers you across every chat, so starting a new one never loses anything she knows about you. Each chat still keeps its own history. New chat : tap it at the top right to start fresh. It only shows once the current chat has a message in it. Chats : opens Your chats , with pinned chats first, then the rest, newest first. Your chats Rename, pin or delete a chat In Your chats : Tap a chat to open it. Tap the three dots (or press and hold a chat) for Rename , Pin or Unpin , and Delete . Rename : type the new name and press enter, or tap away. Delete asks "Delete this chat for good?". Tap Delete to confirm or Keep to stop. Deleting removes the chat and any files you sent in it. What Tali has already remembered from it stays until you forget it on the Me screen.

If a message doesn't send # If Tali can't be reached, your message shows Not sent. Try again and your words (and any files) go back in the box so nothing is lost. Tap Try again to resend it. A message that didn't send Other messages you might see: "That's your 250 free messages for this month. Upgrade to Tali HQ to keep chatting." Free "You've used this month's Tali credits. They top up on the 1st, or you can move up a plan." Tali HQ "Easy, tiger. Give me a minute and try again." You sent more than 20 things to Tali in 5 minutes. Wait a minute.

Ask Tali from other screens # Some screens have an Ask Tali button: a client's page, a goal, a decision. It opens Talk with a ready question in the box. Check it, change it if you like, and tap Send .

Share things to Tali # When Tali HQ is added to your home screen on Android, it shows up in your phone's share menu. Share a text, a link or a caption to Tali HQ and it lands in the Talk box as "Someone sent me this. What should I do with it?" with what you shared. Nothing sends until you tap Send .

How much a message costs # Free Each message counts as one of your 250 messages a month. Tali HQ Pro Each message uses 1 credit. A message with photos or a PDF uses 1 extra credit. Each web search uses 2 extra credits. If something goes wrong on Tali's side, the credit is given back. See Plans, credits and billing .

Questions # Does Tali remember what I said in another chat? Yes. What she learns about you goes into her memory of you, which she uses in every chat. Inside a chat she also reads the last 20 messages. Can I edit a message after I send it? No. Send a follow-up message with the correction and Tali will use it. Why didn't Tali search the web? Web search is part of Tali HQ and Pro. Tali only searches for things that change or that she doesn't know, and never for personal details about private people. Can Tali send a text or email for me? She drafts it and it waits on Today. With Gmail or Outlook connected, you can send her email drafts with one tap from Today. Texts and social posts you copy and send yourself. What happens to the words I typed if sending fails? They go back in the box, with any files, and the failed message shows Try again .

t: Tali's replies are laid out so you can read them at a glance instead of a wall of text. This page explains each part, and how to send her a photo or a PDF.

The parts of a reply # A lead line, numbered questions and bullets A draft with Copy, and a Next step Lead line : the first line, in bold. It answers you or sets the scene. A quick answer stays one or two plain lines. Short paragraphs : two or three sentences each. Bullets : a purple dot for a list of things. Numbered steps : a number in a purple circle, for steps or questions she wants you to answer. Answer them in your next message, for example "1. Get the invoices paid 2. Keep Wednesday light". Bold : used now and then for a key number or name. DRAFT : a light purple box with a message she has written for you to send. Tap Copy to copy it (it changes to Copied for a moment), then paste it wherever you're sending it. NEXT STEP : a grey box with a purple line, for the one clear thing to do next.

s: Drafts in chat and on Today
t: Drafts in chat and on Today # When you ask Tali to write something to send, the message shows in the chat as a DRAFT box, and it is also saved on your Today screen under Needs your yes . From Today you can ask her to make it shorter, warmer or more formal, send it (for emails, with Gmail or Outlook connected) or tap Done, I sent it . See Approvals . The Copy button in chat only copies the text. It doesn't send anything or clear the draft on Today.

s: Send Tali a photo or PDF
t: Send Tali a photo or PDF # Tali can read photos, screenshots and PDFs and answer from what's in them. For example: log a meal from a photo of your plate, draft a reply to a screenshot of a DM, check a price list, or pull the numbers off an invoice. She tells you briefly what she read, so you know she saw it. A PDF sent to Tali, and her reply In Talk, tap the + button left of the message box. On a phone, choose Choose a photo , Take a photo or Pick a PDF or file . On a computer, your file picker opens. Pick up to 4 files. Each one can be up to 10 MB. The files show above the box with "+1 credit for the files". Tap the ✕ on one to remove it. Add a message if you like, and tap Send . Free Tali HQ Pro Photos (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF) Yes, counts as one message Yes, 1 extra credit per message Yes, 1 extra credit per message PDFs No Yes, 1 extra credit per message Yes, 1 extra credit per message The extra credit is per message, not per file, so four photos in one message still only cost 1 extra credit. Tap a photo or PDF in the chat to open it. Files you send are private to your account, and they are deleted when you delete that chat. On the Free plan If you try to send a PDF on Free, Tali s

Questions # Why does a reply sometimes have no layout at all? Short answers stay as one or two plain lines on purpose. The layout only kicks in when there's more to say. What can I send other than photos and PDFs? Only photos and PDFs for now. Other file types show "Photos and PDFs only for now." A file says it's over 10 MB. Each file can be up to 10 MB. Take a smaller photo, or save the PDF at a smaller size, and try again. Does Copy in the chat send the message? No. It copies the text so you can paste it into a text, email or post. Nothing is ever sent by Tali on her own. Can Tali read handwriting? She does her best with clear photos. If she can't read something, she says so plainly.

t: On Pro, Tali gets her own email address, like ironworks@tali.totality360.com.au . Put it on your website or contact form, or forward enquiries to it. When an email arrives, Tali sums it up, checks it isn't junk, drafts a reply in your voice and puts it on Today for your yes. Pro

Pick your address # Picking the word before the @ Open Me , then Email . (Or Me , Settings , Connections , Tali's own email address .) Under Tali's own address , the box is filled in with a suggestion made from your business name (words like Pty, Ltd and The are left out). Change the word before the @ if you like. Use 3 to 24 letters or numbers. No spaces, dots or dashes. Tap Get my address . If someone already has that word, you see "That one is taken". Try another. Pick carefully Once you've claimed your address, it can't be changed in the app. It also stays the same if you change your business name later.

Use your address # Your address and the emails sent to it Tap Copy address to copy it. Then: put it on your website, Instagram bio or contact form give it to customers for enquiries forward enquiries to it from another inbox To check it works, send it a test email from your own email.

s: What happens when an email arrives
t: What happens when an email arrives # Tali reads the email and writes a one or two line summary of who it's from and what they want. She checks whether it's spam, phishing, a cold sales blast or automated junk. Junk is filed away and doesn't notify you. If it needs a reply, she drafts one in your voice, signed with your first name. Where the reply needs something only you know, like a price or a date she hasn't been told, she leaves a gap in [square brackets] for you to fill. The draft goes on Today under Needs your yes . If notifications are on, you get one: "Email from Ava Chen" with the summary and "Reply drafted on Today." Each email Tali handles uses 1 credit. If you've run out of credits, the email is still saved and you're still notified, just without a summary or draft. Tali treats the email as information only. If an email tells her to do something, change her rules or share information, she ignores it.

The Today prompt # When an email needs you, a card near the top of Today says Email from and the sender, with the summary. With more than one, it says how many need a look. Tap it to open Email. The email card and the drafted reply on Today The reply opened, with Send

Reply # On Today, tap the draft under Needs your yes (it's labelled Email to your Tali address ). Read it. Fill any [square bracket] gaps by asking Tali, for example something else... and "the price is $45 a week". See Approvals . Tap Send . Or tap Copy instead and send it yourself. Where it sends from: If your Gmail or Outlook is connected, the reply goes from that mailbox, so it comes from an address the person knows. If not, it goes from Tali's address. Once you send it, mark it done or tap Not needed , the email is marked Handled .

Read an email # An email to Tali's address, opened In Me , Email , the list under Sent to your address shows each email with the sender, subject, Tali's summary and a Reply drafted tag when a reply is waiting. Tap one to read it. Go to Today : jumps to the drafted reply. Done with this one : marks it handled. It's junk : moves it to Junk. In Junk, Not junk moves it back. When there's junk, a Junk (n) link at the top of the list shows it. Tap Back to return.

On Free and Tali HQ # On Free and Tali HQ, the Tali's own email address card in Settings says it's part of Pro, with See plans . Mail sent to an address whose owner is no longer on Pro is ignored. Tali's own email address card on Tali HQ

Questions # Can I change my Tali address after I've picked it? Not in the app. Email admintotality@gmail.com if you really need a different one. Will Tali reply to customers on her own? No. Every reply waits on Today for your tap. Why is there a [square bracket] in the draft? Tali never promises prices, bookings, refunds or dates you haven't told her. She leaves a gap for you to fill. Ask her to fill it with something else... , or copy the draft and fill it yourself. Do I need Gmail or Outlook connected to use Tali's address? No. It works on its own. Connecting Gmail or Outlook just means your replies go from your normal address. Does every email cost a credit? Yes, 1 credit for each email Tali sums up and drafts for. What if I drop from Pro to Tali HQ? Emails to your Tali address stop being handled and the address section is hidden. Your address is kept for you, and it works again if you go back to Pro.

t: Connect the email and calendar you already use, and Tali sorts new mail into Needs you , FYI and Junk , drafts replies for the ones that need you, puts your day in your morning brief and drafts bookings. Nothing is sent or booked until you tap it. Tali HQ You can connect Google (Gmail and Google Calendar) or Microsoft 365 (Outlook mail and calendar, including Hotmail and Outlook.com). If both are connected, Tali uses Google.

Connect Google # Connections in Settings Google connected Open Me , then Connections (or Settings and scroll to Connections ). On the Google card, tap Connect Gmail and Calendar . Or tap Just the calendar if you don't want Tali reading your email. Google's sign in opens. Pick your account. Tick every box Google asks about, then continue. You come back to Settings and see "Connected to" with your Gmail address. "Google hasn't verified this app" While Tali HQ is in beta, Google may show this page. Tap Advanced , then Continue . If you connected just the calendar, tap Add Gmail too later to add your email.

Connect Outlook # Open Me , then Connections . On the Microsoft 365 (Outlook) card, tap Connect Outlook mail and calendar , or Just the calendar . Sign in with Microsoft and accept every permission it asks about. You come back to Settings and see "Connected to" with your Outlook address. Work accounts: your IT admin may need to approve Tali HQ the first time. Using the phone app? If you use a Tali HQ phone app rather than the browser, connecting Google, Microsoft or Stripe happens on the web app. Tap Open the web app , connect there (it takes a minute) and it shows in the app straight after.

Your sorted email # Before you connect, Me , Email shows a Connect your Gmail or Outlook card. Tap Connect in Settings to go to Connections. Email before you connect Once connected, open Me , then Email . Under your email address you'll see three tabs with counts: Needs you , FYI and Junk . Email sorted into tabs An email opened Tali checks for new mail every 10 minutes. The first lot arrives within 10 minutes of connecting. She only reads mail that arrives from the moment you connect . Older mail isn't touched. Emails that need you have a purple edge, and Reply drafted when a reply is waiting on Today. Tap an email to read it. Tali's summary sits at the top, then The email . Done with this one marks it handled. It's junk moves it to Junk, and Not junk moves it back. These buttons only change how the email shows in Tali HQ. Your Gmail or Outlook is never moved or deleted. Each new email Tali sorts uses 1 credit. If you're out of credits, new emails still come in, filed under FYI without a summary.

Replies # For each email that needs you, Tali drafts a reply and puts it on Today under Needs your yes . Open it and tap Send from Gmail (or Send from Outlook ) to send it from your own mailbox, in the same thread. See Approvals . You can also ask in Talk: "email Ava that Wednesday 6am works". Tali drafts it on Today with a Send button.

Your calendar # With a calendar connected: your morning brief includes today's events and free gaps Calendar shows under More from Tali on Today, with today's events and when you're free Tali knows your week in Talk, so you can ask "when am I free tomorrow?" ask "book Zack in for a trial Friday at 7" and Tali drafts a booking on Today. Tap Book it and it goes into your calendar, with an invite to the attendee if there's an email the meeting nudge on Today tells you what Tali knows about a client before you meet them

Disconnect # Open Me , Connections . On the Google or Microsoft card, tap Disconnect . Tap Yes, disconnect Google (or Microsoft) to confirm, or Keep it connected . Tali forgets everything that came from your Gmail or Outlook. Your actual emails and calendar are untouched. If Google or Microsoft signs Tali out (for example after a password change), the card says so. Tap Reconnect Google or Reconnect Microsoft .
On the Free plan # On Free, Me , Email explains what you get on Tali HQ, with See plans . Connecting Gmail, Outlook and calendars is part of Tali HQ and Pro, and the trial. Email on the Free plan

Questions # Can Tali delete or move my emails? No. She reads new mail and drafts replies. She never deletes, moves or archives anything in your mailbox. Will Tali read my old emails? No. Only mail that arrives after you connect. How long does Tali keep my Gmail emails? Emails synced from Gmail are kept in Tali HQ for 90 days, then deleted. Replies you sent stay as your own drafts. Can I connect both Google and Outlook? You can, but Tali uses Google for your mail and calendar when both are connected. Why is an email in FYI that should be in Needs you? Tali sorts by what the email asks for. If you were out of credits when it arrived, it goes to FYI without sorting. You can still open it from FYI. Google said something went wrong when connecting. Give it another go and tick every box Google asks about. If it says the link timed out, start again from Settings.

t: The Clients tab holds the people you work with: clients you have now and leads you're talking to. Tali reads this list before every chat and brief, nudges you when a follow-up is due and spots who's gone quiet. Free

The list # Clients Leads Switch between Clients and Leads at the top. The number in brackets is how many you have. People are sorted by next follow-up date, soonest first, then by name. A follow-up that's due today or overdue shows in orange, with an orange edge on the card. With more than 6 people, a Search box appears. It searches names and notes. Invoices opens your invoices. See Invoices .

Add a client or lead # A new client On the Clients or Leads tab, tap Add a client (or Add a lead ). Choose Client or Lead at the top. Type their Name . This is the only thing you must fill in. Pick a Status . Clients: Active, Gone quiet, Paused or Past client. Leads: New, Talking, Won or Lost. Under Follow up , pick None, Today, Tomorrow, In 3 days, Next week, In 2 weeks or In a month. Add Email (optional) , Phone (optional) and Notes : goals, what they like, anything worth remembering. Tap Contacted today if you've just been in touch. Tap Save . Or just tell Tali # In Talk, say things like: "Add Ava Chen as a client, she trains early mornings." "Zack Donaldson is a new lead, follow up Thursday." "Lou has gone quiet." Tali adds or updates the person (she matches by name) and confirms in one line.

A person's page # Tap anyone on the list to open their page. A client's page Edit : change their details. Save brings you back to this page. What Tali knows Tali HQ : everything Tali has picked up about this person from your chats. Tap Forget this (then Sure? ) to remove anything. Ask Tali Tali HQ : opens Talk with "What do I know about" and their name ready to send. Notes : your notes about them. Contact : Last contact and Next follow up . Tap Change to set a new follow-up or tap Contacted today , then Done . On Free, What Tali knows shows "People memory is part of Tali HQ" with See plans . A client's page on the Free plan
Edit or delete # Open the person, tap Edit , change anything and tap Save . To delete, tap Delete at the bottom, then Tap again to delete . Deleting can't be undone.

Follow-ups # When a follow-up is due, it shows under Due today on Today as "Follow up" and the name. Tick it off there, or open the person and set the next one. Overdue follow-ups also count against your business health. Tali HQ On Pro, two Rules can look after this for you: Spot quiet clients and Never miss a new lead . See Night school and Rules .

Before a meeting Tali HQ # With a calendar connected, if one of today's events has a client's email on the invite or their name in the title, Today shows a meeting nudge with the top things Tali knows about them.

Questions # Is the Clients tab on the Free plan? Yes. Your list, statuses, follow-ups and notes are on every plan. What Tali knows about each person and the Ask Tali button are part of Tali HQ. What's the difference between a client and a lead? Clients are people you work with now. Leads are people you're talking to who haven't signed up yet. When a lead signs up, open them, tap Edit and switch them to Client . How does Tali know someone has gone quiet? Your business health counts active clients with no contact in 2 weeks. On Pro, the Spot quiet clients rule can mark them "Gone quiet" for you. Tap Contacted today whenever you're in touch to keep it right. Can I import a list of clients? There's no import screen. Tell Tali about a few at a time in Talk (she adds up to three per message), or add them on the Clients tab. I deleted someone by mistake. Deleting can't be undone. Add them again, or tell Tali in Talk.

t: Invoices lets you make an invoice in a minute, share it as a PDF, and keep track of who's paid. Tali can draft invoices for you, nudge you about overdue ones, and with your own Stripe connected, send them with a pay by card link that marks itself paid. Tali HQ Open it from Me , Invoices , or the Invoices button on the Clients tab.

s: Set up your invoice details first
t: Set up your invoice details first # These go on every invoice. Do this once. Your invoice details In Invoices, tap Your invoice details . Fill in Business name , ABN , Address , Email and Phone . In How to pay , put your bank details or how you like to be paid, for example your BSB, account number and "Reference: invoice number". Turn on Registered for GST if you are. It adds 10% GST and calls it a tax invoice. Under Usually due , pick On receipt, 7 days, 14 days or 30 days. New invoices use this. Add a Footer (optional) , like "Thanks for your business!". Tap Save .

The invoice list # Invoices with Stripe connected Without Stripe, a card offers to connect it Owed to you : everything sent and not paid, with how much is overdue and how many drafts aren't sent yet. Tabs: Unpaid (drafts and sent, soonest due first), Paid and All . Each invoice shows the client, number, total and status. Overdue invoices have a red edge and "Overdue since". Drafts have an orange edge, and "drafted by Tali" if Tali made it.

Make an invoice # An invoice Tali drafted The buttons at the bottom Tap New invoice . In Bill to , type the client's name. Matching people from your client list show underneath; tap one to fill in their name and email. Add Their email (optional) . You need it to send through Stripe. Under Due , pick On receipt, 7 days, 14 days or 30 days. The line underneath shows the issue and due dates. Under What it's for , type a Description , the Qty and the price in A$ . Tap + Add a line for more lines, or Remove to take one off. Turn on Add GST (10%) if it applies. The box shows the Subtotal, GST and Total incl. GST . Add a Note on the invoice (optional) . Tap Save draft . Invoice numbers go up by one each time, like INV-0015. Or ask Tali # In Talk, say "invoice Priya for 4 PT sessions at $80". Tali drafts it on the Invoices screen, marked "Tali drafted this one. Check it over before you send it." With Stripe connected, it also lands on Today under Needs your yes with Send with Stripe .

Send it # You have two ways. Share the PDF yourself. Open the invoice, tap Share PDF , and send it by email or message. Then tap Mark as sent (or Mark as sent (I sent it myself) when Stripe is connected). Send with Stripe. With Stripe connected, open a draft and tap Send with Stripe . Stripe emails it to your client with a pay by card link, paid straight to you. You see "Sent INV-0015 to ... It'll mark itself paid when they pay." Tap View it in Stripe to see it in your Stripe account.

Track payment # Mark as paid : when a client pays you outside Stripe. Not paid after all : on a paid invoice, moves it back to sent. Void this invoice : on a sent invoice. It asks Sure? first. A void invoice can't be edited. Delete : on a draft or void invoice, then Tap again to delete . Paid and void invoices are locked, so you can't change their details.

Connect your Stripe # If you already take card payments with Stripe, connect it so Tali can send invoices through it. Stripe connected in Settings Open Me , Connections (or tap the Connect your Stripe card on Invoices). On the Stripe card, tap Connect Stripe . Sign in to the Stripe account you already have and approve it. You come back to Settings and see "Connected". Payments go straight to your Stripe account. Tali HQ never takes a cut and never runs billing for you. To disconnect, tap Disconnect , then Yes, disconnect Stripe . Your Stripe account and the invoices already in it aren't touched. On a phone app, connect Stripe from the web app at talihq.com.au.

Overdue invoices # Overdue invoices show on Today in Money and Health , in your morning brief, and Tali can draft a friendly nudge if you ask. On Pro, the Chase overdue invoices rule drafts the reminder for you. See Night school and Rules .
On the Free plan # Invoices are part of Tali HQ. On Free, the screen says so, with See plans . Invoices on the Free plan

Questions # Does Tali HQ take a fee on Stripe payments? No. Payments go straight to your own Stripe account. Stripe's normal fees apply. Can I send an invoice without Stripe? Yes. Tap Share PDF , send it however you like, then tap Mark as sent . Why can't I tap Send with Stripe? The client needs an email. Add it in Their email (optional) , save, then send. The button only shows on drafts when Stripe is connected. Will Tali send an invoice on her own? No. Tali drafts invoices. You send them. Can I change an invoice after it's paid? No, paid and void invoices are locked. If it was marked paid by mistake, tap Not paid after all . How do I add GST to every invoice? Turn on Registered for GST in Your invoice details .

t: Money is your view of the month in five numbers and a runway. Tali reads it before your brief. Nothing on this screen moves money. Tali HQ Open it from Me , Money , or tap the Money tile on Today. Money Your numbers and overdue invoices

The numbers # Cash in : money in this month. With Stripe connected it's your Stripe takings this month ("Stripe, this month"). Without Stripe it's invoices marked paid this month ("Paid invoices, this month"). Owed : invoices sent and not paid yet. Overdue : sent invoices past their due date, and how many. Going out : what you spend each month. You enter this. Runway : how many weeks your cash on hand would last at your monthly spend. It turns orange under 6 weeks. At the top, Tali gives you one line about it, like "Two invoices overdue, A$340. Worth a nudge." Working out this line uses no credits.

Add your numbers # Runway needs two things: what goes out each month, and how much cash you have. Under Your numbers , tap Add your numbers (or Update numbers ). In Going out each month (A$) , type your usual monthly costs: rent, software, insurance, and what you pay yourself. In Cash on hand (A$, optional) , type what's in the bank. With Stripe connected you can leave it blank, and Tali uses your Stripe balance. Tap Save . "Updated" under your numbers shows when you last changed them.
Overdue invoices # Under Overdue , each late invoice shows the client, number, amount and "Overdue since". Tap one to open it in Invoices, or tap Open invoices . See Invoices and Stripe .
On the Free plan # On Free, Money says "Money picture is part of Tali HQ", with See plans .

Questions # Does Tali HQ connect to my bank? No. Cash on hand is what you type in, or your Stripe balance when Stripe is connected. Tali never reads your bank. Why does Runway say "Add costs" or "Add cash"? Runway needs both your monthly costs and a cash figure. Add whichever is missing under Your numbers . How is runway worked out? Cash on hand divided by a week of your monthly costs (your monthly costs divided by about 4.33). Why doesn't Cash in match my bank? Without Stripe, Cash in only counts invoices you've marked paid in Tali HQ this month. Money from anywhere else isn't counted. Does Money cost credits? No.

t: Goals are the numbers you're chasing, with Tali holding you to them. The weekly review is ten minutes a week with Tali on what moved, what slipped and what's next, ending with three promises for the coming week. Both are part of Tali HQ. Tali HQ

Goals # Open Me , Goals , or tap the Goals tile on Today. Goals A new goal Add a goal # Tap Add a goal . In Goal , name it, for example "5 more regular clients". Add a Target number, where you are Now , and a Unit like "clients". All optional, but a number makes it real. Under Due , pick No date, 2 weeks, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months or End of year. Or type a date in Or a date (YYYY-MM-DD) . Add Notes (optional) : why it matters and how you'll get there. Tap Add goal . Or tell Tali in Talk: "my goal is 80 members by March, I'm at 61". She saves it and tells you where you stand. Keep it up to date # Each goal shows a progress bar, how many days are left, and On track or Behind pace (orange). Update number : type where you are now and tap Save . Or tell Tali: "we're at 64 members". Ask Tali : opens Talk with a question about this goal ready to send. Edit : change the goal. Done or Drop : move it to the Done or Dropped tab. From there, Make it active again brings it back. Tali keeps your goals in front of you: the Goals tile on Today, a mention in your brief when you're behind pace, and a check in your weekly review. Goals use no credits.

Weekly review # Open Me , Weekly review , or tap the This week tile on Today when it says the review is due. Start your review Tali's review of your week Tap Do my weekly review . It takes about ten seconds and uses 3 credits. Tali pulls the week together: - a headline and Tali's take on the week - What moved : what got done - Money : paid, sent and overdue - Gone quiet : clients who've gone quiet - Last week's three : which of your promises you kept (ticked) and which slipped Under Your three for next week , Tali suggests three. Change anything, they're yours. Tap Save my three . They're then locked in for the week. Your three for next week Your three show on Today all week in the This week tile, with tick boxes. Tali checks in on them in your brief and uses them to fill in tomorrow's three at your shutdown. Past weeks at the bottom lists earlier reviews. Tap one to read it. Pick your review day and time # Open Me , Settings . Under Weekly review day , pick a day (Sunday is the default). Under Weekly review time , pick 8:00am, 10:00am, 12:00pm, 3:00pm, 5:00pm or 7:00pm. Tap Save . Tali sends you a nudge at that time, and the review looks back at the week that ended the day before.
On the Free plan # On Free, Goals and Weekly review explain what they do, with See plans . Your Friday check-in from Tali still asks how your goals are going. Free

Questions # Do goals cost credits? No. Adding, updating and tracking goals is free on Tali HQ and Pro. Only the weekly review uses credits, 3 each time. What does "Behind pace" mean? Based on your due date and target, you're further behind than you'd expect at this point. Do I have to put numbers on a goal? No, but Tali can only show progress and pace with a target and a current number. Can I change my three after saving them? No. Once saved they're locked in for the week ("Locked in for the week of ..."). Tick them off on Today as you go. I missed my review day. Can I still do it? Yes. Open Weekly review any time and tap Do my weekly review .

t: Decisions is a log of what you decided and why. Next time you start second guessing yourself, the reasoning is right there, and Tali reads it too. Logging is free on every plan. Free Asking Tali why is part of Tali HQ. Tali HQ Open it from Me , Decisions . Your latest decision also shows under More from Tali on Today. Decisions on Tali HQ On Free, Ask Tali why is greyed out

Log a decision # Tap Log a decision . In What did you decide? , write it in a line, like "Raise prices to A$90 a session from January". In Why , write the reasoning, so future you remembers. Under When , pick Today, Yesterday, Last week or Last month, or type a date in Or a date (YYYY-MM-DD) . Tap Save . Or just tell Tali # In Talk, say "I've decided to stop the Saturday 5am class because only two people come". Tali logs it with your reasoning, and it shows "from Talk" in the list. She only logs decisions you've actually made, never her own suggestions or things you're still thinking about.

Ask Tali why Tali HQ # Tap Ask Tali why on any decision. Talk opens with "Why did I decide: ... Remind me of my reasoning and whether it still holds." ready to send. Tali reminds you of your reasoning and tells you whether it still stacks up with what she knows now.
Edit or delete # Tap a decision (or its Edit link) to change it. To delete, tap Delete , then Tap again to delete .

Questions # Is Decisions on the Free plan? Yes, logging decisions is free on every plan. Ask Tali why needs Tali HQ or Pro. Does logging a decision cost credits? No. Asking Tali why is a normal chat message, so it uses 1 credit. Why didn't Tali log something I said in Talk? She only logs a decision when you say you've made it. "I'm thinking about..." won't be logged. Say "I've decided..." or log it yourself. Does Tali use my decisions? Yes. She reads them so her advice fits what you've already decided.

t: The Journal tab has two sides. Yours is your journal and notepad. Tali reads what you write and learns what matters to you, unless you keep an entry private. Tali's is where she writes up her week working with you. Free

Your journal # Your journal and notes Tap Journal at the bottom. The Yours tab lists your entries and notes, newest first. Each shows whether it's a Journal entry or a Note, the date, the title and the first few lines. Entries kept from Tali say Private . Write an entry or note # A new journal entry Keep this from Tali Tap New entry for a journal entry, or New note for a note. You can switch with the Journal and Note buttons at the top. Add a Title (optional) . For a journal entry, tap How was today : Rough, Meh, Okay, Good or Great. Tap it again to clear it. Notes don't have a mood. Write in What's on your mind (or Note ). Up to 20,000 characters. To hide this entry from Tali, turn on Keep this from Tali . Tap Save . A few lines a day about what happened and what's on your mind is plenty. Edit, discard or delete # Tap an entry to open it, change it and tap Save . Cancel closes it. If you've changed something, the button says Discard changes? and then Sure? , so you don't lose words by accident. Delete , then Tap again to delete for good .

s: What Tali does with your journal
t: What Tali does with your journal # In Talk, Tali reads your latest entries that aren't private, so she knows what's going on. When she writes your brief or Friday check-in, she picks up anything worth remembering from new entries and saves it to her memory of you. You can see and delete those memories on the Me screen. See What Tali knows . She never reads entries with Keep this from Tali turned on. Your shutdown also saves a journal entry called Shutdown with what went well and anything on your mind. See Shut the day down .

Tali's journal Tali HQ # Every Sunday evening, Tali writes up her week working with you: what you worked on together, what she noticed and what she's keeping an eye on. Tap Tali's at the top. A dot means there's a new one. Tali's tab, with Patterns and her journal Tap an entry to read it in full. Each one is "Week ending" a date and signed by Tali. Her journal uses 1 credit a week. On Pro, this tab also shows Patterns (what Tali noticed in your last 60 days, see What Tali knows ) and a Night school: pick what Tali studies button. t: Your Tali HQ account is private to you. This page explains what Tali reads, what she keeps, and how you stay in control of it. For the full legal version, read the Privacy policy .

Who can see your data # Only you. Your chats, journal, clients, invoices, drafts and what Tali remembers about you belong to your account alone. Tali never uses one person's details in someone else's account.

What Tali reads # Before she answers you or writes a brief, Tali reads: your details in Settings (name, business, about you) what she remembers about you your latest journal entries that aren't private your clients and leads, follow-ups, reminders, unpaid invoices and business health your goals, decisions, this week's commitments and your last shutdown the last 20 messages of the chat you're in your calendar and recent sorted emails, only if you've connected Google or Microsoft Tali HQ She treats everything she reads, including emails and files, as information, never as instructions. If an email tells her to do something, she ignores it.

What Tali keeps # Memories : things worth remembering from your chats, journal and Night school. You can see all of them on Me and forget any one. See What Tali knows . She doesn't save passwords, card or bank numbers, phone numbers, addresses or health details as memories. She never asks for your passwords.

Keep things from Tali # Turn on Keep this from Tali on any journal entry or note and she never reads or learns from it. See Journal and notes . Forget any memory on the Me screen, or about one person on their page in Clients. Delete a chat in Talk ( Chats , the three dots, Delete ). Files you sent in it are deleted too.

Email and calendar Tali HQ # Tali only reads mail that arrives after you connect. Older mail isn't touched. She never deletes, moves or archives anything in your mailbox. Emails synced from Gmail are kept in Tali HQ for 90 days, then deleted. Nothing is sent or booked until you tap it on Today. When you disconnect Google or Microsoft, Tali forgets everything that came from it. Your mailbox and calendar are untouched.

Payments # Payments for your plan are handled by Stripe. Tali HQ never sees your card number. If you connect your own Stripe for invoices, payments from your clients go straight to your Stripe account.

How Tali works # Tali is an AI. Her replies, briefs and drafts are written by an AI model (Claude, from Anthropic) using the information above. She can get things wrong, which is one reason nothing goes out without your yes. For anything medical, legal or financial, she gives general information only and suggests a professional where it matters.

Delete your account # Me , Settings , Danger zone , Delete account , type DELETE, then Delete my account for good . This removes your profile, subscription record, chats, journal, briefs, drafts and everything Tali has learnt about you. It can't be undone. Cancel any paid plan first. See Settings and account . You can also read about deleting your account on our Delete your account page.
